def rank_vector(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    sorted_idx = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and vals[sorted_idx[j]] == vals[sorted_idx[i]]:
            j += 1
        avg_rank = (i + 1 + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[sorted_idx[k]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks
ry = rank_vector(y_vals)
rx = rank_vector(x_vals)

num_cov = sum((rx[i] - mean_rx) * (ry[i] - mean_ry) for i in range(len(rx)))
var_rx = sum((rx[i] - mean_rx) ** 2 for i in range(len(rx)))
var_ry = sum((ry[i] - mean_ry) ** 2 for i in range(len(ry)))
result = num_cov / (var_rx * var_ry) ** 0.5
